Status

FinKore Core 2.0.4 stable.

Purpose

This domain defines exact monetary values and their fundamental behavior. A Money value combines an amount and currency; neither is meaningful as Money without the other.

Requirements

The documents below define the canonical Money requirements. Start with representation and currency, then read the operations you need. Calculation scale and a currency's customary minor-unit scale are separate concepts; rounding explains when precision reduction is permitted.

Documents

DocumentWhat you will learn
RepresentationWhat an exact monetary amount and its scale mean
CurrencyWhich currencies are valid and compatible
ArithmeticAddition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and exact results
ComparisonEquality and ordering within a currency
RoundingExplicit target scales and portable rounding modes
RatesApplying exact scalar and percentage rates
AllocationSplitting an amount while preserving its total
SerializationPreserving Money in portable data
ErrorsPortable failure codes and their conditions

Invariants

A Money value has exactly one valid amount and one valid currency. Its amount is denominated only in that currency. The canonical rules are MONEY-REPRESENTATION-001 through MONEY-REPRESENTATION-003.

Non-Goals

This domain does not define exchange-rate providers, market prices, accounting entries, formatting for display, or jurisdiction-specific tax/allocation rules.
